cnTitle: 紫微斗数七杀朝斗、仰斗格：同样七杀坐命，为什么有人是将才有人只是折腾
enTitle: Qi Sha Facing and Aspiring Toward the Dipper: Why One Seven Killings Chart Leads and Another Just Struggles
enDesc: When Seven Killings sits in Yin/Shen/Zi/Wu with Zi Wei and Tian Fu across, plus assistants and good transformations, it forms the Facing/Aspiring pattern; malefics and void stars breaking it reduce the chart to mere struggle.
cnDesc: 七杀在寅申子午守命、对宫紫府拱照，再会到辅弼昌曲魁钺禄权科才叫朝斗仰斗；见四煞空劫冲破则破格，差别全在有没有辅佐与制化。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数财荫夹印格：天相被武曲天梁夹住，为什么主稳、主有人托底
enTitle: Wealth-and-Shade Clasping the Seal: When Tian Xiang Is Held by Wu Qu and Tian Liang
enDesc: When Tian Xiang holds the Life or a key palace and its two neighbors are Wu Qu (wealth) and Tian Liang (shade/protection), or Lu Cun joins, it signals steady resources, elder backing and rescue in crisis—one of the rare auspicious "clasping" patterns.
cnDesc: 天相守命或守重要宫位，两邻被武曲（财）与天梁（荫）夹住，或带禄存，主资源稳、长辈荫庇、逢凶有人解，是少有的「夹宫吉格」。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数刑忌夹印：天相被化忌与擎羊夹住的受制格，别和刑囚夹印搞混
enTitle: Punishment-and-Ji Clasping the Seal: Tian Xiang Constrained by Hua Ji and Qing Yang, Distinct from Prisoner-Seal
enDesc: When Tian Xiang is clasped by Hua Ji (often Tian Liang Hua Ji) plus Qing Yang or Tian Xing, it signals constraint, obstruction, contract/document pressure and disputes. It differs from Prisoner-Seal (Lian Zhen-Tian Xiang with Qing Yang) and must be read separately.
cnDesc: 天相两邻被化忌（多为天梁化忌）与擎羊、天刑一类夹住，主受制、掣肘、文书契约压力与官非；它和廉相遇擎羊的刑囚夹印是两个格，要分开断。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数善荫朝纲格：天机天梁在辰戌，善谋略、讲原则的幕僚型格局
enTitle: Kindness-and-Shade Upholding Order: Tian Ji and Tian Liang in Chen/Xu, the Strategist-Principle Pattern
enDesc: Tian Ji (kindness/strategy) and Tian Liang (shade) holding Life in Chen or Xu, joined by assistants and good transformations, signals intelligence, strategy and principle, suiting advisory, oversight, education and consulting; with malefics it turns aloof, full of ideas but short on results.
cnDesc: 天机（善）与天梁（荫）在辰宫或戌宫守命，再会辅弼昌曲禄权科，主聪明有谋略、守正有原则，宜幕僚、监察、教育、专业顾问；见煞则孤高、想法多而成事少。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数天乙拱命、坐贵向贵：天魁天钺怎么排布才算贵人成格
enTitle: Heavenly Nobles Supporting Life and Sitting/Facing the Noble: How Kui and Yue Form a Benefactor Pattern
enDesc: Tian Kui is the yang noble and Tian Yue the yin noble. One in Life and the other across is Sitting/Facing the Noble; nobles in the trine or clasping Life is Heavenly Nobles Supporting Life. It signals help at key moments, but benefactors do not do the work for you.
cnDesc: 天魁为阳贵、天钺为阴贵，一在命宫一在对宫称坐贵向贵，两贵分守三方或夹命称天乙拱命；主关键时刻有人提携，但贵人不是替你干活的人。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数文星拱命、昌曲夹命：文昌文曲怎么会出读书、考证与名声的格
enTitle: Literary Stars Supporting Life and Chang-Qu Clasping: How Wen Chang and Wen Qu Build Study, Credential and Reputation Patterns
enDesc: Wen Chang and Wen Qu sharing Life, clasping it or trining it, joined by Hua Ke or Lu Cun, signal clear thinking, strong expression and exam ability, and reputation through expertise or writing; with malefics/voids the intelligence scatters or stays broad but shallow.
cnDesc: 文昌文曲同宫守命，或分守命宫两邻、三方拱照，再会化科禄存，主思维清晰、表达与考试能力强、靠专业与文字出名；见煞空则聪明不用在正途或学得多而不精。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数辅弼拱主格：左辅右弼为什么是「帝星能不能成事」的关键
enTitle: Assistants Supporting the Ruler: Why Zuo Fu and You Bi Decide Whether the Emperor Star Delivers
enDesc: When Zi Wei holds Life and Zuo Fu/You Bi share, clasp or trine it, the Assistants Supporting the Ruler pattern forms: leadership with execution and a reliable team. Without them the emperor star is a lone ruler doing everything alone.
cnDesc: 紫微守命，左辅右弼同宫、夹命或在三方四正拱照，称辅弼拱主，主领导力有人执行、容易得助力班底；若紫微无辅弼，纵有帝星也容易孤君无依、凡事亲力亲为。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数几个常见凶格合看：马落空亡、劫空夹命、火铃夹命到底在说什么
enTitle: Common Harsh Patterns Together: Horse Falling into Void, Voids Clasping Life and Fire-Bell Clasping
enDesc: Horse into Void is the Travel Horse meeting void stars—effort scattered; Voids Clasping Life has Di Kong/Di Jie as neighbors—resources leak; Fire-Bell Clasping brings anxiety and sudden shocks. These are structural warnings, not fixed doom.
cnDesc: 马落空亡是天马遇地空地劫、奔波白忙，劫空夹命是两邻被地空地劫夹住、资源易散，火铃夹命是火星铃星夹命、焦躁与突发冲击；它们都是「结构提示」，不是定死的凶。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数六煞怎么排：为什么擎羊陀罗总夹着禄存、火铃空劫位置有规律
enTitle: How the Six Malefics Are Placed: Why Qing Yang-Tuo Luo Always Flank Lu Cun and Fire-Bell-Void Follow Rules
enDesc: The six malefics are not random: Qing Yang/Tuo Luo are set by the year stem and always flank Lu Cun; Huo Xing/Ling Xing are placed by year and hour branches; Di Kong/Di Jie sit adjacent. Understanding placement explains why certain combinations are inevitable.
cnDesc: 六煞不是随机落的：擎羊陀罗由年干定位、永远一左一右夹着禄存，火星铃星按年支与时支安，地空地劫相邻而坐，看懂排布规律就明白为什么某些组合必然出现。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数地空地劫和截空旬空差在哪：一组主破散、一组主打断，别混着断
enTitle: Di Kong/Di Jie vs. Jie Kong/Xun Kong: One Scatters, the Other Interrupts—Do Not Mix Them
enDesc: Di Kong/Di Jie are the void pair among the six malefics—scattering resources and mental/material loss. Jie Kong/Xun Kong (Xun Kong/Tian Kong) are a separate void-auxiliary set—interruption, suspension and discounting good things. They differ in origin, strength and how events manifest.
cnDesc: 地空地劫是六煞里的一对空曜，主资源破散、精神与物质的落空；截空旬空（旬空、天空）是另一组空亡杂曜，主打断、悬置、让好事打折。两组来源、力量和应事方式都不同。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数六吉星会聚怎么才算成格：左辅右弼、天魁天钺、文昌文曲不是越多越好
enTitle: When the Six Auspicious Stars Truly Form a Pattern: Assistants, Nobles and Literary Stars Are Not "the More the Better"
enDesc: The six auspicious stars are three pairs—Zuo Fu/You Bi, Tian Kui/Tian Yue, Wen Chang/Wen Qu. To form a pattern they must share the major star's palace or trine it without being broken by malefics/voids; scattered stars are decoration; aligned, supporting and protecting the major star is real help.
cnDesc: 六吉是左辅右弼、天魁天钺、文昌文曲三对，要成格须与主星同宫或在三方四正拱照、且不被煞星空亡破坏；零散几颗只是点缀，凑得齐、拱得正、护得住主星才算助力成局。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数制煞为用：煞星庙旺、被主星镇住时，破坏力怎么变成执行力
enTitle: Turning Malefics to Use: How Exaltation and a Strong Major Star Convert Destructive Force into Drive
enDesc: Malefics are not only to avoid: an exalted malefic has a container for its force and can be directed; steady major stars like Zi Wei/Tian Fu/Tian Xiang can subdue it, and Hua Quan/Hua Ke plus assistants can harness it—then it becomes boldness, execution and resilience.
cnDesc: 煞星不是只能躲：庙旺的煞力道有容器、能被驾驭，紫微天府天相等稳重主星能镇煞，化权化科与辅星能收煞，煞被制住时反而主魄力、执行力与逆境韧性。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数天刑、天月、天伤、天使、阴煞这组暗曜小煞怎么合看：不主大凶、主慢性消耗
enTitle: Tian Xing, Tian Yue, Tian Shang, Tian Shi and Yin Sha: Subtle Auxiliary Malefics That Mean Chronic Drain, Not Major Disaster
enDesc: Tian Xing is aloofness/legal matters, Tian Yue chronic minor ailments, Tian Shang/Tian Shi drain and worry, Yin Sha hidden mental knots. Far lighter than the six malefics, they mostly adjust the score and amplify only when sharing a palace—no need to fear their names.
cnDesc: 天刑主孤克与法律、天月主慢性小恙、天伤天使主损耗与牵挂、阴煞主暗中心结，这组小煞力量远轻于六煞，多作加减分，同宫才放大，不必见名色变。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数一六共宗是什么：命宫和疾厄宫为什么要当一个宫看
enTitle: What Is "One-Six Shared Root" in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Why Life and Health Palaces Are Read as One
enDesc: Count Life as one and Health six steps counterclockwise: One-Six share a root and rise/fall together. Likewise Two-Seven, Three-Eight, Four-Nine, Five-Ten. These numeric palace pairs reveal the surface, cause and hidden line of any matter.
cnDesc: 以命宫为一、逆数到疾厄为六，一六共宗、一荣俱荣；同理二七同道、三八为朋、四九为友、五十同途，这套宫位数字关系专门看一件事的表里、因果与暗线。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数命宫身宫怎么排出来：安命身宫诀一步步推，不再靠软件黑箱
enTitle: How the Life and Body Palaces Are Cast: Deriving Them Step by Step Instead of Trusting the App Black Box
enDesc: Life/Body placement uses the rule: start the first month at Yin, count forward to the birth month, then count the birth hour from Zi—counterclockwise places Life, clockwise places Body. Understanding it lets you verify any app yourself.
cnDesc: 安命身宫用「斗柄建寅起正月，数至生月顺行，子时起数生时，逆回安命、顺安身」：从寅宫起正月顺数到生月，再从该宫起子时逆数到生时安命、顺数安身，理解后能自己校验软件对错。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数闰月出生怎么排：三派处理法与「两张盘对照定盘」
enTitle: How to Cast a Leap-Month Birth in Zi Wei Dou Shu: Three Schools and the Two-Chart Verification
enDesc: Leap-month casting has three schools: always next month, always current month, or split at day fifteen. Each has merit; the sound method casts both charts and verifies against personality and past events, using whichever resonates.
cnDesc: 闰月排盘有三派：一律按下月、一律按上月、以十五为界前半月当月后半月下月；各派都有道理，稳妥做法是两盘都排，用性格与过往大事定盘，哪张更应就用哪张。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数本命、大限、流年三层怎么叠着断：谁定底色、谁定阶段、谁定事件
enTitle: How to Layer Natal, Decade and Annual Charts: Who Sets the Baseline, the Stage and the Event
enDesc: The natal chart sets lifelong structure, the decade chart sets the ten-year theme, the annual chart sets this year's trigger. Each has its role: qualify by natal, read momentum by decade, time by year—never let the annual override the natal.
cnDesc: 本命盘定一生底色与结构，大限盘定十年阶段主题，流年盘定当年触发事件；三层各司其职，断事要先本命定性、再大限看势、最后流年定时，不能拿流年盖过本命。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数星曜五行和宫位五行怎么生克：同一颗星进不同宫，为什么力道不同
enTitle: Five-Element Relations Between Stars and Palaces: Why the Same Star Hits Differently by Palace
enDesc: Each star has a five-element nature (Wu Qu metal, Tian Ji wood) and each branch palace has an element too; stars and palaces generate, control or support each other. Supported/grounded stars express, controlled/drained ones discount—another strength layer beyond brightness.
cnDesc: 每颗星有五行属性（如武曲属金、天机属木），十二个地支宫也有五行，星与宫之间存在相生相克相扶；得生、得地则星性舒展，受克、被泄则力道打折，这是庙旺之外另一层强弱判断。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数两颗主星同宫怎么分主次：同宫不是各说各话，要看谁主谁辅
enTitle: Which Major Star Leads When Two Share a Palace: Not Equal Voices but a Primary and a Secondary
enDesc: When two majors share a palace (Zi Wei-Tian Fu, Tian Ji-Tai Yin), rank them by brightness, transformations, palace theme and star strength: the lead sets the tone, the secondary adds color, and malefics may pull it—never just average the two meanings.
cnDesc: 紫微天府、天机太阴等双星同宫时，要按庙旺亮度、四化落点、宫位主题与星性强弱分主次：主星定基调，辅星添色彩，再看是否被煞星牵引，不能把两颗星的含义简单对半拼。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数飞化路线怎么追：从一个宫的天干，一步步看清「谁让谁发生」
enTitle: How to Trace a Flying-Transformation Route: From One Palace's Stem to "Who Causes What for Whom"
enDesc: Palace-stem flying reads: palace A's stem transforms a star sitting in palace B into Lu/Quan/Ke/Ji, meaning A's matter acts on B in that mode. Follow the route hop by hop to reveal the causal chain—do not skip steps or lose the thread.
cnDesc: 宫干飞化讲的是A宫的天干让某颗星化禄权科忌、那颗星坐在B宫，就读成「A宫这件事，以禄权科忌的方式作用到B宫」；沿路线连追几跳，因果链就清楚了，关键是别跳步、别飞丢。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数四化两两同宫怎么断：禄权、禄科、权科、权忌、科忌差别一次讲清
enTitle: Reading Two Transformations in One Palace: Lu-Quan, Lu-Ke, Quan-Ke, Quan-Ji and Ke-Ji Explained
enDesc: When two transformations share a palace, a single image becomes a paired one: Lu-Quan is wealth plus drive, Lu-Ke gains through reputation, Quan-Ke is professional standing, Quan-Ji is fast in and fast out, Ke-Ji is slow repetition. Each pair reads differently.
cnDesc: 一个宫位同时落两种化，事情才从单象变成双象：禄权主财利与行动力、禄科主因名得利、权科主专业立身、权忌主来得快去得快、科忌主拖拉反复，组合不同断法完全不同。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数自化化权、自化化科：硬撑与好面子，为什么能量会在宫里自己耗掉
enTitle: Self-Transformed Quan and Ke: Forced Control and Face-Consciousness, and Why Energy Dissipates Inside the Palace
enDesc: When a palace's own stem transforms a star back in that same palace into Quan or Ke, it is self-Quan/self-Ke: self-Quan is willful competitiveness that ends hollow, self-Ke is self-polishing where reputation outruns substance—both cycle energy inside the palace, hard to capture externally.
cnDesc: 宫干化出的权或科正好落回本宫主星，叫自化权、自化科；自化权主主观好胜、争到最后空欢喜，自化科主自我修饰、外在评价高于实际，二者都是能量在本宫内部循环、难以外收。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数禄随忌走、忌出忌入：为什么有的钱到手又走，追着化忌才看得懂
enTitle: Lu Follows Ji and Flying-Ji Out/In: Why Some Money Arrives and Leaves—Follow Hua Ji to Understand
enDesc: Lu and Ji are a causal pair: where Lu gives, Ji collects—Lu follows Ji. Ji-in means energy gets stuck in a palace; Ji-out means a palace pushes its debt outward. Following where Lu comes from and Ji goes explains why gains and losses repeat.
cnDesc: 禄和忌是一对因果：化禄在哪给、化忌就在哪收，称禄随忌走；忌入是能量卡进某宫、忌出是某宫把亏欠推出去，顺着「禄从哪来、忌往哪去」追，才看得懂得失为何反复。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数化忌在本宫和冲对宫差在哪：忌坐、忌冲力量不一样，别一起吓
enTitle: Hua Ji in the Home Palace vs. Clashing the Opposite: Sitting-Ji and Clashing-Ji Differ in Force—Do Not Fear Both Equally
enDesc: Ji sitting in a palace blocks that palace's matter for direct work; its opposite palace simultaneously receives the "Ji clash," tending to external/result-level turbulence. Sitting is an inner knot, clashing is impact across—the force and response differ.
cnDesc: 化忌坐某宫是这一宫的事被卡住、要正面补课；化忌在某宫则其对宫同时受「忌冲」，被冲的宫多主外部、结果层面的动荡。坐是内里打结，冲是对面受波及，轻重和应对都不同。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数哪些盘信号提示感情高危：不是一煞定生死，而是多信号叠加要提前经营
enTitle: Which Chart Patterns Signal High Relationship Risk: No Single Malefic Decides—Stacked Signals Call for Early Work
enDesc: Risk rises when Spouse has Hua Ji clashing, a lone malefic, or moving/solitary stars, and the decade Spouse is empty yet clashed. A single signal is only tendency; what matters is how many stack, whether the decade activates them, and how you manage in reality.
cnDesc: 夫妻宫化忌冲、煞星独坐、动星寡宿聚集，再叠大限夫妻宫空而受冲，才把分手风险抬高；单一信号只代表倾向，关键看信号叠了几层、大限有没有引动，以及现实里怎么经营。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数夫妻宫空宫怎么看感情：不是没姻缘，而是借对宫、形态更随环境变
enTitle: How to Read Love When the Spouse Palace Is Empty: Not No Partner, but Borrowing the Opposite and Shaping to Circumstance
enDesc: No major star in Spouse is an empty palace: borrow the opposite Career palace's stars and read the trine. Empty does not mean no marriage; relationship form is less fixed and shaped by work environment and partners, with stability depending on borrowed stars and the decade.
cnDesc: 夫妻宫无主星称空宫，要借对宫官禄的主星来读，并看三方四正与煞辅；空宫不等于不婚，而是感情形态不太固定、容易被工作环境和相处对象塑造，稳定性取决于借来的星和大限。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数不婚、独身倾向怎么看：是孤寡之星还是关系需求本来就低
enTitle: How to Read an Inclination to Stay Single: Solitary Stars or Simply a Lower Need for Partnership
enDesc: A single-person inclination forms when Life/Spouse carry Gu Chen/Gua Su, aloof stars like Tian Ji/Tian Liang or clustered voids, and Karma prefers solitude. It describes relationship needs and rhythm, not destined non-marriage; choice stays with the person.
cnDesc: 命宫夫妻宫见孤辰寡宿、天机天梁等孤高星或空曜聚集，加上福德宫偏好独处，才构成「独身倾向」；但它描述的是关系需求与节奏，不是注定不婚，选择权始终在人。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数复合、旧情回头怎么看：看缘分有没有断、大运有没有重新引动
enTitle: How to Read Reconciliation and an Ex Returning: Whether the Bond Truly Ended and Whether a Stage Reactivates It
enDesc: Reconciliation is not whether an ex remembers you, but whether the bond line remains (Life-Spouse transformations still connect), whether the current decade/year reactivates the relationship palace, and whether the original structural problem can be solved—all three give it meaning.
cnDesc: 复合不是看对方会不会想起你，而是看两人缘分线是否未断（命宫夫妻宫四化仍有牵连）、当前大限流年是否重新引动关系宫，以及当初分开的结构性问题能不能解，三者齐才有意义。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数配偶远近、年龄差怎么看：夫妻宫、迁移宫与桃花星合参
enTitle: How to Read Partner Distance and Age Gap: Combining the Spouse, Travel and Romance Stars
enDesc: Whether a partner is near or far, long-distance/cross-border, and the age gap come from Spouse stars (moving stars/Tian Ma far, steady stars near), Travel-Spouse transformation links, and where romance stars like Tian Yao/Hong Luan land—showing which direction partnership tends to come from.
cnDesc: 配偶是近是远、是否异地跨国、年龄差大小，要合参夫妻宫星曜（动星天马主远、静星主近）、迁移宫与夫妻宫的四化牵连，以及天姚红鸾等桃花落位，看出缘分通常从哪个方向来。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数职场晋升、被提拔看什么：官禄飞化卡大限流年，时间点这样找
enTitle: How Zi Wei Dou Shu Reads Promotion and Sponsorship: Timing It Through Career Flying Transformations Across Decade and Year
enDesc: Promotion is more than the Career major star: set the natal Career role, trace its stem's Lu/Quan landing palace, and the decade/year that reaches that landing is the sponsorship window—Quan promotes, Lu raises pay, a Ji clash warns of change.
cnDesc: 升迁不是只看官禄宫主星，要先定本命官禄的角色，再追官禄宫干化禄化权落在哪一宫，大限、流年走到该落宫时就是提拔窗口；遇权升职、遇禄加薪，化忌冲则防变动。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数官司、诉讼、是非怎么看：巨门天刑擎羊化忌的组合，重点是提前防契约漏洞
enTitle: How Zi Wei Dou Shu Reads Disputes and Litigation: Combinations of Ju Men, Tian Xing, Qing Yang and Hua Ji, with the Focus on Preventing Contract Gaps
enDesc: Litigation tends to involve Ju Men (speech disputes), Tian Xing (legal liability), Qing Yang (hard collision) and Hua Ji (debt/block), rising when in Life/Career/Karma/Travel or activated by decade/year. It predicts no specific lawsuit but flags when to tighten contracts, evidence and conduct.
cnDesc: 官非诉讼多与巨门（口舌）、天刑（法律刑责）、擎羊（硬碰冲突）及化忌（亏欠卡点）有关，落在命、官、福、迁移或被大限流年引动时风险升高；它不预言谁告谁，而是提示哪一阶段要特别管住合同、证据与言行。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数适不适合做副业、斜杠：官禄看主业，夫妻宫（官禄对宫）看第二曲线
enTitle: Are You Suited to a Side Hustle? Career Shows the Main Job and Its Opposite (Spouse Palace) Shows the Second Curve
enDesc: The main job reads from Career; a side hustle from its opposite Spouse palace plus Wealth/Travel. Tan Lang/Tian Ji favor multi-track work, Sun-Moon/Chang-Qu favor dual roles, Lu/Tian Ma favor earning through motion. The key is whether the side income can transact independently of your employer, not short-lived buzz.
cnDesc: 主业看官禄宫，副业看官禄的对宫夫妻宫与财帛、迁移的配合；贪狼天机多角经营、日月昌曲主身兼二职，化禄天马主动中生财，关键是副业能否脱离原平台独立成交，而不是一时热闹。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数负债、破财后怎么看翻身：先看破财结构，再看修复走到哪个周期
enTitle: How to Read Recovery After Debt and Loss: First the Loss Structure, Then Where You Are in the Repair Cycle
enDesc: Recovery first classifies the loss (Tan Lang-Ji expansion out of control, Wu Qu-Ji hard gap, voids leakage), then uses Wealth/Property/Career and the decade to stage repair: stop-bleeding, accumulation and turnaround map to different stars and timing—slow, but recoverable.
cnDesc: 负债翻身要先分破财类型（贪狼化忌的扩张失控、武曲化忌的硬缺口、空劫的漏散），再用财帛、田宅、官禄与大限判断修复阶段：止血、积累、翻身各对应不同星曜与时间，急不得也翻得过来。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数晚年、退休运怎么看：末限大限、福德宫与田宅宫一起看
enTitle: How to Read Later-Life and Retirement Fortune: The Final Decades Together with Karma and Property Palaces
enDesc: Later-life quality is more than money: combine the final two decades' stars, Karma (inner peace), Property (home and asset base) and Wealth (cash flow). Tian Tong/Tian Liang/Tai Yin favor tranquil blessings; Sha-Po-Lang/Wu Qu mean staying active or late blooming.
cnDesc: 晚年生活质量不只看有没有钱，要合参最后两步大限（末限）的星曜、福德宫（内心安不安）、田宅宫（居所与资产底盘）与财帛（现金流）；天同天梁太阴主清福，杀破狼武曲主晚年仍忙或大器晚成。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数搬家、迁居、换城市怎么看：迁移宫定外部机缘，田宅宫定扎根状态
enTitle: How to Read Moving and Relocating: Travel Palace Sets External Opportunity, Property Palace Sets Rootedness
enDesc: Whether to leave home, which direction, and how smoothly moving goes combine Travel (outer world/away fortune), Property (living/rooting), Tian Ma (motion) and decade activation. Travel stronger than Life often means developing away from home; steady Property favors putting roots nearby.
cnDesc: 适不适合离开家乡、去哪个方向、搬家顺不顺，要合参迁移宫（外部世界与外出运）、田宅宫（居住与扎根）、天马（动象）与大限引动；迁移强于命宫者多「离乡发展」，田宅稳者更宜就近扎根。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数流年事业变动、升迁怎么看：流年官禄与大限本命叠着断
enTitle: How to Read Annual Career Change and Promotion: Layer the Year Career Palace over Decade and Natal
enDesc: Whether the year brings promotion, change or stability comes from layering the annual Career palace and annual transformations over the decade and natal Career: annual Quan/Lu into Career with an upward decade means promotion or a good move; annual Ji clashing Career warns of change and communication costs.
cnDesc: 当年事业是升、是动、是稳，要把流年官禄宫、流年四化与大限官禄、本命官禄叠看：流年化权化禄入官禄且大限走升，主升迁或跳槽向好；流年化忌冲官禄则防变动与沟通成本。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数流年财运好坏怎么断：流年财帛、化禄化忌与大限消费周期合看
enTitle: How to Judge Annual Wealth: Combine the Year Wealth Palace, Lu/Ji and the Decade Spending Cycle
enDesc: Whether the year earns or loses depends on the annual Wealth stars and where annual Lu/Ji fly, layered over whether the decade Wealth accumulates or spends; Lu into Wealth/Property raises income, Ji clashing Wealth or meeting voids/Tian Ma calls for controlling spending and investment impulse.
cnDesc: 今年是进财年还是破财年，要看流年财帛宫星曜、流年化禄化忌飞入，再叠大限财帛是积累期还是支出期；禄入财帛田宅主增收，忌冲财帛或会空劫天马则控支出、防投资冲动。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数流年健康、出行怎么看：流年命宫叠疾厄福德，只作风险管理不作诊断
enTitle: How to Read Annual Health and Travel: Layer the Year Life over Health and Karma—Risk Management, Not Diagnosis
enDesc: Annual health/travel reads whether the year Life overlaps natal Health/Karma and whether annual Ji, Tian Xing/Tian Yue or malefics clash them; it flags when to rest, get checkups and travel carefully—a tendency, not a diagnosis; always rely on formal medical care.
cnDesc: 当年健康与出行，要看流年命宫是否叠本命疾厄、福德，及流年化忌、天刑天月、煞星是否冲这些宫；它提示哪段时间要多休息、做体检、出行谨慎，是倾向不是诊断，任何不适以正规就医为准。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数命盘能不能随便给别人看：隐私、心理暗示与被断语绑架
enTitle: Can You Show Your Zi Wei Chart to Anyone? Privacy, Suggestion and Being Held Captive by Verdicts
enDesc: Showing your chart does not alter fate or reduce fortune; the real concerns are three: birth data is personal privacy, a harsh verdict can create self-fulfilling suggestion, and no one should make decisions for you. Consult reliable people and protect your birth information.
cnDesc: 命盘给别人看本身不会「被改运」或「折福」，真正要注意的是三点：出生信息属个人隐私、别被一句坏断语造成心理暗示、以及别让别人替你做决定；找靠谱的人、保护好生辰信息即可。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数和西方星座、塔罗到底差在哪：三套工具的分工一次说清
enTitle: How Zi Wei Dou Shu Differs from Western Astrology and Tarot: What Each Tool Is For
enDesc: Western sun-sign astrology uses the tropical zodiac and mainly birth date for a personality sketch; Tarot draws cards on the spot for question-specific divination and reflection; Zi Wei casts twelve palaces and a hundred stars from lunar birth data for lifelong structure and timing—different granularity, basis and use.
cnDesc: 星座按太阳回归黄道、主要依生日定太阳星座，偏性格速写；塔罗是当场抽牌、针对具体问题的占卜与启发；紫微按农历生辰排十二宫百颗星，偏一生结构与时间节奏，三者粒度、依据和用途都不同。
